stage1.impression: A warm, dim, plausibly laid-out bar that reads at once as CG: the floor is a field of denoiser blotches, the materials go soft and smooth at 1:1, and the shelf edges and bar-top lights look like neon strips and small glowing phone screens. The one EARF speaker is a small red smudge at the vanishing point, out-shone by a cool grey wall screen, so the frame has no hero. Mood and palette are on brief, but the craft is not near a magazine photograph.

blocking_9: Floor and shadow areas free of denoiser blotching and smear at 1:1 (polished floor reflections resolve as clean, slightly broken highlights, not mottled patches)

The Ember speaker reads as the hero at a glance: it fills at least about 8% of the frame height, its region lum_median >= 45, and it is the most saturated and most attention-holding thing in the frame
No neutral glowing surface (wall screen, shelf edges, pendants) out-shines or out-sizes the speaker; screen median below the speaker's
Board-formed concrete, checked fir beams and blackened-steel patina visible at 1:1 at delivery size (tie holes, board grain, edge sharpness)
Shelf lit edges and bar-top inlay read as architectural light (soft, warm, low), not LED signage or screens
The right foreground booth holds shadow detail (crush_pct < 10) and the left foreground is more than a dark mass
Visible signs of life (a coat on a stool, glasses with liquid, a record out of its sleeve) and variety among the identical stools
Pendant tubes show a soft frosted gradient, not flat clipped white

defects.what: Floor is mottled with large denoiser blotches and smeared reflection pools; the strongest CG giveaway
Ember speaker tiny, distant and dim (median 40.6, delta E 18.8 against a deep red reference); it reads as a red lamp, not a $20k horn speaker; silhouette and acrylic not legible
Wall screen is the largest bright area (median 90) and cool grey-blue (b > r), so it competes with the speaker and reads as a TV
Shelf lit edges read as thin white neon/LED strips (p95 156), signage-like rather than glowing thick acrylic edges
Bar-top inlay lights read as small bright rectangles like phone screens or price tags (clip 0.38%)
Pendant tubes flat white with clipping (2.6%), no frosted falloff; the three pendants look like identical CG cylinders
Right foreground booth and table crushed (crush_pct 23.6), leather and fir cap illegible
Stools are repeated identical copies in a perfect row; foreground is a dark, soft mass (median 15)
Fir beams and ceiling smooth and smeared; no checks, nail holes or end grain
Concrete reads as a generic noisy plaster texture, no board-form lines or tie holes
Smoked acrylic partition and record wall barely readable; partition has no visible edge, thickness or reflection
Whole frame soft (proof at 0.3 scale) with no sign of life: no people, coats, drinks being poured

changes.problem: The speaker, the frame's only colour and its reason to exist, is a tiny smudge at the vanishing point.

evidence.measured: speaker spans about 40 x 50 px of 720 x 480 (about 10% of height including stand glow), median 40.6

change.to: about [7.5, 2.6, 1.25] m (seated height, mid-room by the booths), 40 mm, aimed at the Ember speaker, focus on the speaker at about f/4, so the bar and stools still lead in on the left and the speaker fills roughly a fifth of the frame height

changes.expected: Speaker silhouette, red tint and light through its acrylic read at a glance; the bar and booths become framing rather than subject; floor area and its smear shrink in the frame.

changes.problem: Denoiser smear and blotches on the floor and in the shadows give the render away.

evidence.measured: mottled patches visible in a 2x crop; falloff bins 29.8 to 11.5 are uneven with blotches rather than a smooth pool

change.setting: render samples / adaptive / clamp, and floor polish
change.to: samples 1024, adaptive 0.005, clamp 3, floor's polish lowered to a honed finish (roughness about 0.35 with a faint roughness variation map)

changes.expected: Floor reflections become soft, slightly broken pools of the pendant and speaker light with fine grain, not blotches; shadow regions resolve with fine noise instead of smear.

changes.problem: The speaker is under-lit relative to the frame and its red reads as a lamp.

evidence.measured: lum_median 40.6 (target 45 or more), r 61 g 35 b 30, delta E 18.8 against #B3261E

change.setting: the Ember speaker's area lamps and pinholes
change.to: 4 x area, 55 W/m2, 2700 K, with the two front lamps moved to graze the cabinet's sides so the acrylic's edges and horn mouth catch light

changes.expected: Speaker region median about 55 to 70 with its edges glowing and the white batts visible through the red acrylic.

changes.problem: The cool grey wall screen is the brightest large area and pulls the eye from the speaker.

evidence.measured: lum_median 90.3, r 90 g 90 b 96 (cooler than everything else in the room)

change.to: 0.18, with the frosted panel's roughness raised so the image blurs further into fog

changes.expected: The screen sits as a soft, warm-grey glow below the speaker's brightness; the frosted panel diffuses rather than displays.

changes.problem: The back-bar shelves' lit edges read as white LED strips, nightclub signage rather than thick polished acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 156 against a median of 13.9; thin hard white lines

change.to: 0.3, and warmer (2400 K-equivalent colour) so the edges glow amber and light the bottles above them

changes.expected: Shelf edges become a warm glint along thick acrylic; bottles catch small highlights; no strip reads as neon.

changes.problem: The foreground booth and table are crushed, so the cozy near zone is a black hole.

change.to: 6 x point, 200 W, 2700 K, with a candle in an amber votive on the nearest booth table

changes.expected: The leather and fir cap of the nearest booth hold detail in a warm pool, with dark between the pools.

changes.problem: The bar top's inlay reads as scattered phone screens and the room is empty of life.

evidence.measured: small hard white rectangles, clip_pct 0.38, p95 71

change.setting: the bar top's inlay emission, and props
change.to: inlay 0.8 (a continuous warm line, not dots); add a coat over one stool, two half-full rocks glasses with ice, a record out of its sleeve on the bar, and turn or offset alternate stools a few degrees

changes.expected: The bar top reads as a lit fir surface with a glow along its edge; the row of stools stops reading as copies; the room looks just left.

changes.problem: Pendants are flat clipped cylinders and the concrete, fir and steel read as smooth CG at 1:1.

evidence.measured: pendant clip_pct 2.6, median 168.6, no gradient; concrete at [600, 0, 720, 280] and beams at [0, 0, 720, 120] show no board lines, ties or checks

change.setting: pendant lamps and the frosted acrylic roughness; the concrete's and fir's finish
change.to: pendant lamps 1.5, tubes 0.15 with frosted roughness raised so the tube shows a hot core fading to its ends; concrete with board-form height and tone variation (150 mm boards, tie holes at 600 mm), fir beams with checks and darker end grain, steel with an uneven brown patina sheen

changes.expected: Pendants glow softly without clipping; materials read at their real scale at delivery size.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speaker larger or move it forward out of the listening room
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's size and the room's layout (listening room behind the smoked partition) are fixed; the camera change c1 addresses scale instead.

out_of_scope.request: Thicken the smoked acrylic partition or give it a visible frame
out_of_scope.why: The partition is part of the room's design as proposed; only its lighting and finish may change.
